what_this_is: The signed half of the measurement. results.json is mechanical: it fixes the populations and traces identifiers without judgement. This file pairs each norm in direction A with the breakdown it answers, or records that there is none to pair it with. Every pairing carries the file that states it. The verdicts are mine and are contestable; the populations they range over are not, and are complete.

verdicts.precipitated: a breakdown is documented in this repository, dated, and the norm follows it
verdicts.decided: the norm arrives by a decision, with no breakdown documented before it
verdicts.anticipated: the norm is reasoned out in advance, against a failure that had not happened
verdicts.founding: the norm is present before this practice had run a night, so nothing it did can have caused it
verdicts.undetermined: the norm's genesis is not in this repository

dating: Norms are dated by the record, not by git. The one place the two disagree is tools/pulse_nodes.py, whose adding commit carries author date 2026-08-12 and a subject naming Session 50, while its contents are Session 51's night of 2026-08-13. Where they disagree the journal governs, and the disagreement is reported rather than resolved.

the_typology.finding: The register reshaped its own instrument four times, each time at an error the existing types could not hold, and then stopped.

extensions.type: E — Designed error / Observer classification error
extensions.occasion: 'After Session 3 a new error class is necessary'

extensions.type: F — Tool blindness (available tool not deployed)
G — Pragmatic error / Error of address (formal correctness without the condition of reception)
H — Oscillation Error / Error of Overcorrection

the_typology.then: Registers 010 through 021 record 'no new type' in every session from 12 to 24. Register 010 reads the absence as a signal in its own right: 'the taxonomy may be approaching closure for this phase of research.'

the_closing.finding: The register was not forgotten. It was closed by another norm, with the reason written down.
the_closing.quotation: Minting a new error-register file for F-039/F-040. Declined, following S22's precedent and for the same reason it gave — not every session must create another internal artifact to cite; doing so raises the very index this session measures. Logged here and in genealogie.md instead.
the_closing.reading: The index being raised is this practice's own closure index, its measure of how far it is talking only to itself. So the instrument built to make fallibility verifiable was shut down by the instrument built to detect self-reference. Both are this practice's own. F-039, F-040 and F-041 exist in journals and in no register; the register's last file is Session 24, 2026-07-13.
